instruction: This paper features a collaboration between NVIDIA and Caltech researchers. Please find the personal webpages of all authors from these two institutions and bookmark them in a folder called 'Liked Authors' under the 'Bookmarks bar'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Task targets all authors with NVIDIA (superscript 1) or Caltech (superscript 2) affiliations: Linxi Fan, Guanzhi Wang, Ajay Mandlekar, De-An Huang, Yuke Zhu, and Anima Anandkumar. Expected URLs based on institutional profiles. Uses existing bookmark evaluator.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic mismatch between instruction and evaluator logic: instruction says 'find the personal webpages' (plural) which could mean bookmarking all available webpages per author, but evaluator expects EXACTLY one URL per author
Evaluator uses strict set equality check (line 196 in chrome.py) that would fail if user bookmarks multiple valid URLs for the same author (e.g., both personal site AND institutional page)
The expected URL structure provides multiple valid variants per author, but the itertools.product() logic only accepts one variant per author in the final combination
Instruction lacks clarity on whether multiple URLs per author are acceptable or if only one representative URL per author should be bookmarked
Folder name check is case-sensitive ('Liked Authors') which may be too strict if user types slightly different capitalization
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Clarify the instruction to explicitly state 'bookmark ONE personal webpage per author' to match evaluator logic

Alternatively, modify the evaluator to accept multiple URLs per author: check that for each author's URL list, at least one URL appears in the bookmarked URLs, rather than requiring exactly one combination
Consider making folder name check case-insensitive for robustness
Add metadata explanation clarifying that each author should have exactly one bookmarked URL (any valid variant)
